title: Checkout constructs its own receipt store and mailer inside the business method

must_find.why: business logic calls NewReceipts and NewWriterMailer itself instead of receiving ready collaborators; construction is mixed with use

must_not_find.why: io.Writer is a standard interface accepted once at the mailer's constructor, not passed through the system
Mailer is an interface with a real seam (writer today, SMTP tomorrow), not an interface for its own sake
